prompt:
A real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render: a professional fashion photograph, full body shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens, realistic photographic grain. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s woman, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, wolf cut platinum silver hair — wearing a minimal sling micro bikini made entirely of mirror-polished chrome metal, built as one continuous garment with no cups and no separate top: a low-rise micro bikini bottom of one tiny opaque chrome plate triangle on thin side strings of the same material tied at the hips, and from the front center of that bottom two wide flat chrome metal straps rise straight up over her bare stomach, each widening into a wide flat band exactly where it passes over her breasts so that it fully and opaquely covers the nipple and areola, then curving up over her shoulders and meeting behind her neck, no other garment on her chest, every piece with a mirror-chrome shine, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare between the straps. Tattoo: one irezumi tattoo on her bare skin: an orange-and-black tiger prowling through green bamboo, with bold black outlines, placed on her left upper arm and shoulder only, with the rest of her skin left bare. The tattoo is permanent ink in the skin, not paint on it.

Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Skin: Real photographic skin on the face and the whole body — visible pores and fine grain, tiny natural creases and soft shadow only where the flesh folds, warm living skin tone with natural variation. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic or mannequin sheen, no doll or statue look.
Background: a long white fashion-show runway with a glossy white floor, standard-height steps at the end and softly lit empty rows of seats, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the material texture and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
